interval_years.quote: All persons practicing as dispensing opticians shall register with the division director and shall pay a biennial registration fee in an amount determined by the board, on or before the renewal date established by the division director.

required.quote: Each person who holds a license as a dispensing optician shall be required to complete ten hours of continuing education prior to each renewal of such license.

hours_per_period.quote: Each person who holds a license as a dispensing optician shall be required to complete ten hours of continuing education prior to each renewal of such license.

period_years.quote: Each person who holds a license as a dispensing optician shall be required to complete ten hours of continuing education prior to each renewal of such license.

available.quote: Any person who has been duly licensed to practice as a dispensing optician in any state of the United States which has a standard of qualifications and examination for such practice at least as high as that provided for in this state by this chapter ... may, upon proper application to the board and upon payment of a fee in an amount established by the board in lieu of examination and registration fees, be issued a certificate of registration without examination

requirements.value: Licensed in another state with qualifications at least as high as Georgia's; principally engaged in practice for not less than two years; reciprocal privilege offered by home state; applicant must not have failed any required Georgia examination within the preceding five years.
requirements.quote: Any person who has been duly licensed to practice as a dispensing optician in any state of the United States which has a standard of qualifications and examination for such practice at least as high as that provided for in this state by this chapter and who has been principally engaged in such practice pursuant to such license for a period of not less than two years preceding may, upon proper application to the board and upon payment of a fee in an amount established by the board in lieu of examination and registration fees, be issued a certificate of registration without examination

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant or licensee is not of good moral character
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board shall refuse to issue its certificate of registration and may revoke its certificate of registration issued to any person who is not of good moral character

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commits an act involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: who commits an act involving moral turpitude
who is guilty of highly unprofessional conduct

disciplinary_grounds.quote: whose certificate was issued through error, fraud, or perjury

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of board rules and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The violation of such rules and regulations shall be grounds for the revocation of any license issued under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly made misleading, deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in practice or in obtaining a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly made misleading, deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in the practice of a business or profession licensed under this title or on any document connected therewith; practiced fraud or deceit or intentionally made any false statement in obtaining a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a felony or crime involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted of any felony or of any crime involving moral turpitude in the courts of this state or any other state, territory, or country or in the courts of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: License revoked, suspended, or denied by another lawful licensing authority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Had his or her license to practice a business or profession licensed under this title revoked, suspended, or annulled by any lawful licensing authority other than the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in any unprofessional, immoral, unethical, deceptive, or deleterious conduct harmful to the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in any unprofessional, immoral, unethical, deceptive, or deleterious conduct or practice harmful to the public that materially affects the fitness of the licensee or applicant to practice a business or profession licensed under this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aided or assisted an unlicensed person to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly performed any act which in any way aids, assists, procures, advises, or encourages any unlicensed person or any licensee whose license has been suspended or revoked by a professional licensing board to practice a business or profession licensed under this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a statute, law, or any rule or regulation of this state or the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated a statute, law, or any rule or regulation of this state, any other state, the professional licensing board regulating the business or profession licensed under this title, the United States, or any other lawful authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudged mentally incompetent by a court
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been adjudged mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction within or outside this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to illness or substance use
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Displayed an inability to practice a business or profession licensed under this title with reasonable skill and safety to the public or has become unable to practice the licensed business or profession with reasonable skill and safety to the public by reason of illness or the use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material

definition_quote.value: an individual who is duly licensed to prepare and dispense lenses, spectacles, eyeglasses, contact lenses, and optical devices to the intended user thereof as specifically directed or authorized on the written prescription of a physician skilled in diseases of the eye or an optometrist duly licensed to practice his profession.
definition_quote.quote: an individual who is duly licensed to prepare and dispense lenses, spectacles, eyeglasses, contact lenses, and optical devices to the intended user thereof as specifically directed or authorized on the written prescription of a physician skilled in diseases of the eye or an optometrist duly licensed to practice his profession.

methods_authorized.quote: prepare and dispense lenses, spectacles, eyeglasses, contact lenses, and optical devices to the intended user thereof as specifically directed or authorized on the written prescription of a physician skilled in diseases of the eye or an optometrist

contact_lens_scope_included.quote: prepare and dispense lenses, spectacles, eyeglasses, contact lenses, and optical devices to the intended user thereof

artificial_eye_scope_included.quote: nor shall anything in this chapter be construed to affect in any way the manufacturing and sale of plastic or glass artificial eyes or any persons engaged in the manufacturing or sale of plastic or glass artificial eyes.

duplicate_without_prescription_allowed.quote: A dispensing optician may duplicate lenses without prescription

written_prescription_required.quote: The services and appliances relating to optical dispensing shall be dispensed, furnished, or supplied to the intended wearer or user thereof only upon prescription issued by a physician or an optometrist; but duplications, replacements, reproductions, or repetitions may be done without prescription

contact_lens_followup_required.quote: Dispensing opticians who dispense contact lenses shall instruct the wearer at the time the lenses are delivered to return to the prescribing and responsible optometrist or physician skilled in diseases of the eye for evaluation, approval, and follow-up care.

unlicensed_assistant_tasks_permitted.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to prohibit an unlicensed person from performing merely mechanical work upon inert materials in an optical office or laboratory.

fee_splitting_with_prescriber_prohibited.quote: It shall be unlawful for any dispensing optician, either directly or indirectly, to participate in any manner in the division, assignment, rebate, splitting, or refunding of service fees or costs of completed eyeglasses or parts thereof with a physician, optometrist, or other person or persons.

apprenticeship_minimum_hours.quote: The practical training and experience required under this paragraph for an apprenticeship shall include, at a minimum, 3,000 hours of experience engaged in apprenticeship functions

apprenticeship_curriculum_subjects.quote: shall include instruction in ophthalmic optics, optical laboratory materials and techniques, eye anatomy and physiology, related laws and regulations, ophthalmic dispensing theory and application, and basic contact lens theory.

school_program_substitution_for_apprenti.quote: The applicant has satisfactorily completed one school year of not less than an 850 hour course of study in a recognized school of optical dispensing or has had practical training and experience of a grade and character satisfactory to the board for not less than two years

apprentice_registration_required.quote: Prior to beginning an apprenticeship, the applicant shall register with the board.

scope_excludes_eye_examination_and_presc.quote: a dispensing optician shall not substitute contact lenses for spectacles, eyeglasses, or other optical devices except as otherwise authorized in this chapter or engage in the diagnosis of diseases of the human eye or attempt to determine the refractive powers of the human eye or in any manner attempt to prescribe remedies for or treat diseases or ailments of human beings.

unlicensed_mechanical_work_exemption.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to prohibit an unlicensed person from performing merely mechanical work upon inert materials in an optical office or laboratory.

ready_made_nonprescription_eyewear_exemp.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to prevent the sale of spectacles for reading purposes, toy glasses, goggles, or sunglasses consisting of plano white, plano colored, or plano tinted glasses or ready-made nonprescription glasses
